title: stelleropsis altaica subsp. tianschanica
intro: Stelleropsis altaica subsp. tianschanica, commonly known as Tianshan mountain cotton grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Liliaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, anti-cancer and antimicrobial activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to confirm the plant's efficacy and safety for medicinal use, but it has shown promise in traditional medicine for various ailments.
